title: Generic transcript line
description: One line of the engine's interchange transcript format (format "generic", docs/universal.md "Any other harness"): what an adapter writes for a harness om has no reader for, and what om itself records under <root>/transcripts/<harness>/<session>.jsonl for a harness whose hook payload carries the turn (HookSpec.Record). A line without an id gets "g" and its line number; a line that is already a Pi message entry (type "message") is read as is, and a line of any other role is skipped. Source: memory/transcript/generic.go (Generic), memory/cli/hook.go (recordTurn).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339; recordTurn stamps the time it recorded the line when the payload had none.
